description: Fetch one bounded page of existing PBS items for a test level so append proposals can review likely duplicates.

continuationToken.description: Opaque token returned by the preceding existing-PBS page. Use it by itself.

pageSize.description: Initial-call page size from 1 to 100; defaults to 25.

projectId.description: RiskRover project ID. Defaults to the configured project.

testLevelId.description: Test level to read on the first page.
